The setting is an indoor space with a grey stone-textured pillar in the background. (2) A person's hand enters the frame and points to a blue microphone icon on the touchscreen labeled '開始對話'. The UI changes to show a yellow listening icon and text '正在聆聽...'. The avatar remains relatively still, blinking occasionally. (3) The screen displays the text '你好' as the system processes the audio. The digital avatar's mouth begins to move, synced with synthetic speech. A progress bar with a plane icon appears at the bottom. (4) The camera zooms in on the avatar's face as more text overlays like '早安' and '歡迎來到台北松山機場' appear. A small red heart icon pops up near the avatar's collar for a moment. The screen remains active with the avatar looking at the viewer.

A synthetic, professional male voice from the AI robot begins speaking, delivering a clear greeting: 'Nihao... Haluo! Zaoan...'.
